svg.title: ModelFest: predicted versus observed detection thresholds
svg.desc: reference stand-in detector, 41 analytic stimuli. RMS error 1.97 dB over all, 1.60 dB over the 8 skin-relevant shapes. Points on the line are perfect predictions; points above it mean the model needs more contrast than observers did. Per-stimulus values are in modelfest.json.

svg.text: Observed threshold, mean of 16 observers (dB; lower = more sensitive)
Above the line: the model needs more contrast than observers did. Below: it predicts the feature as easier to see.
Not predicted (random or photographic, not parametric): #35 Binary noise 1 arcmin; #43 Natural scene (San Francisco).
Observed: ModelFest baseline data, Watson & Ahumada 2005, J. Vision 5(9):6. Per-stimulus table: modelfest.json.
